title: Harden anonymous /search/v2/search with migration errors, 20/min rate limit, 30-minute edge TTL, and deprecation headers

endpoints.before: Anonymous POST /search/v2/search requests redirected (303) to GET /search/v2/search under an origin-only 60 requests/minute search rate limit without deprecation headers.
endpoints.after: Marked deprecated with Deprecation: true and Link: <https://devs.egdata.app>; rel="successor-version" headers. POST /search/v2/search continues to return a 303 redirect to GET /search/v2/search, while anonymous traffic is rate-limited to 20 requests/minute at both the Worker edge and origin with a migration prompt pointing to https://devs.egdata.app and /v1/search (and the followed GET enforces anonymous limit<=28 and page<=10 caps).
endpoints.clientAction: Create a free API key at https://devs.egdata.app and migrate to GET /v1/search.

endpoints.before: Anonymous GET /search/v2/search accepted limit up to 100 and unbounded page numbers with a 5-minute (300s) CDN cache TTL and an origin-only 60 requests/minute search rate limit without deprecation headers.
endpoints.after: Marked deprecated with Deprecation: true and Link: <https://devs.egdata.app>; rel="successor-version" headers. At the Cloudflare Worker gateway, anonymous GET/HEAD /search/v2/search requests exceeding limit=28 or page=10 return 403 MIGRATE_TO_V1 pointing to https://devs.egdata.app and /v1/search; anonymous requests are edge-rate-limited to 20 requests/minute per IP before cache lookup (429 RATE_LIMITED with migration prompt); and anonymous edge cache TTL is raised from 300s to 1800s (30 minutes). Origin RateLimitTier::Search default is lowered from 60 to 20 requests/minute with the same migration prompt. Authenticated API key and trusted first-party callers retain full pagination and limit up to 100.
endpoints.clientAction: Create a free API key at https://devs.egdata.app and migrate to GET /v1/search (which supports limit up to 100, cursor pagination, fields=card, and GET /v1/search/facets).
